rationale: The original relay main saved BEST/run_end but omitted score/best_update/retry/quit/pause/resume. The corrected onEvent emits one score per finished standard run and best_update only on strict improvement; retry applies from result, quit carries current score/time, and pause/resume emit only when the active or restored mode is standard playing. Practice does not send competitive lifecycle or update BEST. This is a source-level event contract check, not a browser event-count claim.
